description:
The United Kingdom said Tuesday it will deploy fighter jets to defend Saudi Arabia against attacks by the Iran-allied Houthi rebels in Yemen. The UK will fly “defensive counter-air missions” using Royal Air Force Typhoon fighter jets to protect Saudi cities and critical infrastructure, the Defense Ministry said in a statement.

The conflict has been intensifying since the Houthis announced in July that they would target Saudi shipping in the Red Sea as well as infrastructure inside the kingdom, following a Saudi attack on the Houthi-controlled airport in the Yemeni capital, Sanaa. The Yemen government has urged the United Nations to designate the Houthis as a terrorist group.

description:
In a well-written speech last week delivered against the magnificent backdrop of the Acropolis in Athens, Secretary of State Marco Rubio urged the West to rediscover what makes it exceptional. He described the qualities that define Western civilization as “the fire of passion, strength, courage, pride,” and he celebrated its ambition, nationalism and relentless pursuit of excellence. He warned that the West has become ashamed of the very things that made it great.

CNN’s Fareed Zakaria in his take, argues that Rubio is wrong about what makes the West exceptional. Also, Fareed talks to former Canadian deputy prime minister Chrystia Freeland on President Trump’s decision to waive sanctions on Russia and and the resulting breakdown between Trump and Zelensky.
